title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: GRANT D. VENERABLE FAMILY RESIDENCE
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: GRANT D. VENERABLE FAMILY RESIDENCE

  CHC-2026-3234-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-3235-CE  Council District: 8 – Harris-Dawson
  Plan Area: South Los Angeles  Last Day to Act: 11-28-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS: 2921 South Budlong Avenue

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Determine that the proposed designation is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Section 15308, Class 8 and Article 19, Section 15331,
  Class 31 of the State CEQA Guidelines;
  2. Determine whether the property conforms with the definition of a Monument pursuant to Los Angeles
  Administrative Code Section 22.171.7; and
  3. Recommend that the City Council consider and declare the subject property a Historic-Cultural
  Monument.

  Owners:  Santiago M. Pamplona and Corinne A. Bower; Audrey Lopez

  Applicant:  West Adams Heritage Association

  Preparers:  Raymond C. Hurley and Laura Meyers
summary: The Cultural Heritage Commission will decide whether the Grant D. Venerable Family Residence at 2921 South Budlong Avenue meets the definition of a monument, and if so recommend that City Council declare it a Historic-Cultural Monument.

locations.text: 2921 S Budlong Ave, Los Angeles, CA
